purpose: Fully reconcile 151 currently unphotographed canonical Place covers against existing user choices, approved media and unpublished original-image research without falsely treating known files as missing.
policy: Original Photo Finder decisions are binding editorial state; never silently replace a selected image or override 'NONE_SELECTED'.
The 24 selected source holds are distinct from ten remaining selected PD-self sources; rights, attribution, SHA1 and original acquisition require their exact per-source clearance.
The 23 reviewed Places hold 64 already byte-verified sources, but only 21 Places have at least one eligible COVER_CANDIDATE; Pukekaraka Otaki and La Tirana have gallery/context photos only.
First-look, metadata eligibility, site category membership and geotag proximity do not prove user image choice, building identity, rights or publication authorization.
A verified source byte does not approve cropping, licensed derivative attribution, architectural freedom of panorama or underlying artwork rights.
No source URL, photograph, crop or saint artwork is to be automatically promoted to assets/approved/place-media, gallery registries, or the GitHub Pages public app.
All 151 Place records retain current bilingual illustrative fallbacks until separately approved.

review_groups.action: Resolve original frozen rank-1 selected file, licence, author, SHA1, size and duplicate conflicts without alternative substitution.
Recover original selected Commons byte after HTTP rate-limit / rights verification holds; recheck exact source revision and rights.
Side-by-side original visual review of existing verified photos; explicit cover choice and rights/crop/attribution clearance.
Keep context photography as possible gallery, not cover; seek exact-site cover separately if desired.
Do not override user's previous decision; maintain illustrated fallback unless explicitly reopened.
Reuse site/category/custodian source leads; new exact-site search only when genuinely necessary.
